tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Spotify catalog by name to find ids for the other tools. `type` picks what to search: tracks, artists, albums or playlists. Returns up to `limit` hits (max 20) with id, name, key fields and open.spotify.com URL, plus `results` (id such as track:<id>, title, url) for the fetch tool. For tr

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full record behind a search result: a track (play count, album, release date, genres, moods, BPM, credits), an artist (monthly listeners, followers, world rank, top cities, top tracks), an album (every track with play counts) or a playlist (details and its first 50 tracks with play counts). tools.name: get_tracks
tools.description: Track details for up to 50 tracks in one call: name, artists, album, release date, duration, explicit flag, popularity, ISRC and (by default) lifetime play count. include_insights adds genres, moods, activities, BPM, credits, lyrics flag and languages. A play count of 0 means fewer than 1,000 plays.

tools.name: get_track_play_count
tools.description: Lifetime Spotify play counts (streams) for up to 50 tracks in one call, with track name, artists and release date. The fastest way to compare streams. A play count of 0 means fewer than 1,000 plays.

tools.name: get_track_insights
tools.description: Genres, moods and activities (with Spotify's 0-1 weights), tempo in BPM, credits (writers, producers), lyrics flag and vocal languages for up to 50 tracks.

tools.name: get_artists_stats
tools.description: Monthly listeners, followers, world rank, popularity, genres and top 5 cities (with listener counts) for up to 50 artists in one call.

tools.name: get_artist_overview
tools.description: One artist's profile: monthly listeners, followers, world rank, top cities, top tracks with play counts, latest release, discography counts, related artists, biography and social links.

tools.name: get_artist_insights
tools.description: An artist's sound profile from their top tracks: genres, moods and activities with 0-1 weights, and tempo (average, min, max BPM). Up to 20 artists per call.

tools.name: get_related_artists
tools.description: Artists Spotify lists as related to ("Fans also like") the given artist.

tools.name: get_album
tools.description: An album with its track list and (by default) every track's lifetime play count, plus the album total, release date, label, UPC and popularity.

tools.name: get_playlist
tools.description: A playlist's name, owner, followers and description, plus `limit` tracks (max 100) from `offset` with lifetime play counts. Use next_offset from the answer to page through long playlists (later pages skip the metadata and cost one request).

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Spotify Charts by country: top_tracks (Top 200), viral_tracks (Viral 50, daily only), top_artists or top_albums. Each entry has rank, previous and peak rank, days (or weeks) on the chart, movement and, for top_tracks, the streams in that period. Defaults to the latest published daily chart.

tools.name: isrc_lookup
tools.description: Find the Spotify track(s) for an ISRC (International Standard Recording Code), e.g. USUG11904206. Returns ids, names, artists, album and release date.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
